title: Letters from England, 1846-1849
author: Elizabeth Davis Bancroft

authorInfo.bio: Elizabeth Davis Bancroft (1803–1886) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.
authorInfo.edition: Complete source text and original edition credits retained.

description: "Letters from England, 1846-1849" by Elizabeth Davis Bancroft is a collection of personal letters written during the mid-19th century. The book shares the experiences of the author, who is the wife of the American historian and statesman George Bancroft, as she adjusts to life in England after moving there for her husband's diplomatic role.
